# Ledger adapter evidence

`terra-supported-execution.json` projects one public Terra Classic execution captured on 2026-10-14 from the supported `columbus-5` node, app `4.0.1-patch.3` / Cosmos SDK `v0.53.6`. Original execution hash, height, code, logs and events remain intact. Decoded transaction bodies were omitted and the total narrowed to one execution. Mock block headers are synthetic. `terra-supported-empty.json` preserves the exact supported empty shape: null pagination and top-level zero total. `terra-network.json` records public network/version provenance.

The `REAL_HASH`, multi-page, base64 and fault variants in `hardening.rs` / adapter unit tests are explicitly synthetic. They exercise recorded schema behavior and failure handling without production credentials. BSC HTTP fixtures simulate chain 56, canonical block/log identities, source-order reversal, provider caps, missing fields, removed logs and divergent forks. No fixture requires an archive node.

The guarded Postgres scenarios assert actual persisted balances, transfer identities, cursor/hash state, recovery epochs and immutable frozen weights. They exercise replay, registration boundaries/concurrency, transaction cancellation, source-height binding, stale provider timestamps, independent workers, readiness, poisoned intents, SIGTERM and process restart. Parent integration verifies the combined restricted API/freeze migrations; deployment logs and live wallet signing remain separate operational evidence.

Native balance wire schemas: [Cosmos SDK ABCI query](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cosmos/cosmos-sdk/v0.53.6/proto/cosmos/base/tendermint/v1beta1/query.proto) and [Wasm SmartContractState](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CosmWasm/wasmd/v0.54.1/proto/cosmwasm/wasm/v1/query.proto). The configured gateway stripped observation headers and rejected native LCD ABCI; explicit Comet RPC was verified by the parent and by the read-only `probe_terra_rpc` example. The exact implementation produced a native response-height observation at public height 30830198 on 2026-10-14. This is transport evidence, not a production deployment claim.
